subject: Excess NA's and error "subscript out of bounds"

messages.author: 985e455b8390aae3
messages.subject: Excess NA's and error "subscript out of bounds"
parts:
Ian quickly pointed me in the right direction with my last simple
query. Now I've hit a weird one.

In my unmarkedFramePcount, there seems to 6558 extra rows of all NA's,
every covar has 6558 NAs (plus a few "real" NAs). For example:

Tabulation of y observations:
0 1 2 3 4 5 6 <NA>
2011 641 226 80 29 6 6 6558

There are only 2999 records in my dataframe..any idea where 6558 NA
records are coming from or how to eliminate them?

Also, when I try to run a model I get the error:

Error in .local(umf, ...) : subscript out of bounds

...could that have to do with all of these spurious NA records?

Shane Siers

messages.author: 681fb59733e01a1e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Excess NA's and error "subscript out of bounds"
parts:
hi Shane,
 maybe your spreadsheet file had a ton of white space at the end of it. Edit that and remove the empty rows (I had a similar issue awhile back and this is how I resolved it).
regards
andy
